summary: One place for the papers. The top bar loses the second entry (知识库, which opened the same page as 论文库); the page is called 论文库 (was 论文整理) and switches between 列表 and 图谱 (was 论文库 | 知识图谱); inside the graph the two views are 论文关系 and 学习图 (the latter was '学习图 + 论文', renamed at the owner's request); the 整理建议 button and its dialogs are 整理分类; the export dialog is 导出论文库. The page remembers whether the person was on the list or the graph when they come back to it.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-layers, after c770db8. Names and entry points only; no data, endpoint or storage change.

budget_impact.rationale: Labels and one remembered UI mode in the browser; no model call, no network, nothing stored.
budget_impact.before: two top-bar entries and four names for one page
budget_impact.after: one entry, one name; list and graph inside
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: browser preview on a seeded copy
additional_checks.scope: top bar shows 今日 / 论文库 / 画像; page title 论文库; tabs 列表 / 图谱; leaving for 画像 and coming back returns to 图谱

open_risks: docs/*.md (PRODUCT, ARCHITECTURE, older HANDOFF entries) and code comments still use the old names for the same page.
The hidden legacy section #view-library ('我的论文库') in index.html is never shown (the top bar opens the organization page) but is still in the file; not removed in this change.
Any saved link or habit that clicked the old 知识库 entry now lands on the list, not the graph, the first time; after that the page remembers.
